column1: # The viewer's price table (v0.26.10.6 spec R13), for dollar estimates only — every figure the viewer prices is
# labelled "API-equivalent, not your bill". US dollars per million tokens, from the providers' published API prices
# on the as-of date, read from the source pages below; updated only by a release. One line per model, as transcripts
# and job records name it: <model> <input> <cacheRead> <cacheWrite (5-minute)> <cacheWrite1h> <output>, tab-separated.
# A model not here, `unknown`, `default` or `mixed` is "model not priced". Left out on purpose, so they read "model
# not priced": a model whose published price depends on the request's length (claude-haiku-5-5 above 100,000
# prompt tokens; the OpenAI models ViD runs, whose prices change at 272,000 input tokens), since a usage record sums many requests and no one
# rate is true of the sum. Lines starting # are notes.
